title: Northern lights over a cabin

clues.text: every pine is the same perfect christmas-tree shape
smooth snow with no tracks, no texture, nothing

note: aurora, cozy cabin, perfect snow. a little too dreamy 🙈

title: Pastries in a bakery case

clues.text: the same little leaf doodle on every single label
the croissants blur into one golden pile

note: a real baker would get bored drawing the same leaf 🙈

title: Bikes by a canal

clues.text: tulips posed like a postcard, not one wilted
mushy reflections under crisp houses

note: so pretty it hurts. honestly that's the tell

title: Butterfly on pink flowers

clues.text: no legs holding on: it just floats on the flower

note: butterflies have six legs. this one has… vibes 🙈

title: Film camera on a table

clues.text: the lens numbers are a jumbled mess
the dial numbers don't follow any real order

note: no brand, scrambled numbers. cameras are hard for ai

title: Turquoise river in a canyon

clues.text: tiny boats as clean white blobs
cliff texture that repeats like wallpaper

note: honestly? nearly perfect. that's the scary part

title: Cappuccino with a heart

clues.text: a blank sugar packet: real ones always have print
a heart so symmetric it looks stamped on

note: blank packet. real cafés print their names on everything

title: Tabby on a windowsill

clues.text: a very, very long cat that never seems to end

note: that cat is about three cats long 🙈

title: Chess at a café table

clues.text: the squares don't line up into a real grid
captured pieces in a neat little army

note: count the squares, babe. i dare you

title: Clock in a train station

clues.text: 10:10, the time every ad clock shows
platform numbers floating in the air

note: it's always 10:10 in ai land 💜

title: Laptop on a wooden desk

clues.text: a pull chain hanging off the pole, not the lamp
a tidy demo app: ai loves a perfect screen

note: too tidy. real desks have crumbs and seven tabs open

title: Flamingos in a lagoon

clues.text: the reflections don't match the birds above them

note: the reflections are doing their own thing 🙈

title: Red fox in the snow

clues.text: a breath cloud that floats like a sticker
fresh snow with no paw prints around it

note: where did it walk from? no tracks at all

title: Tree frog on a leaf

clues.text: toes that melt into soft orange blobs

note: cute frog. suspicious toes

title: Hedgehog in autumn leaves

clues.text: every spine the same length, like a brush
leaves arranged like a set, not a forest floor

note: this one fooled half the lab

title: White horse in the mist

clues.text: the fence wire can't decide if it's in front or behind

note: the wire goes into the horse. spooky 🙈

title: Kitchen counter in the morning

clues.text: the knife slides under the bread like a ghost
perfect golden light on every single thing

note: styled like a photoshoot that never happened

title: Koi crowding the surface

clues.text: fish bodies blend where they overlap
fins that grow from odd places

note: count the fins. go on

title: Paper lanterns at night

clues.text: flawless text, perfect glow: ai got good at signs

note: the writing is perfect now. this is why it's getting hard 🙈

title: Library shelves and a ladder

clues.text: every famous classic, lined up like a reading list

note: nobody's shelf is only the greatest hits

title: Lighthouse at blue hour

clues.text: a glowing lamp with no beam and no glare

note: perfect blue hour, perfect waves. too perfect?

title: Living room with a fireplace

clues.text: dozens of books and not one readable title

note: cozy… but try reading one spine

title: A stack of macarons

clues.text: the leaning macaron splits open like a mouth

note: it's looking at me 🙈

title: Fruit stall with chalkboards

clues.text: every apple flawless: no bruises, no stickers

note: real fruit has bad days. this fruit never did

title: Misty mountain lake

clues.text: the mirrored peaks don't match the real ones

note: check the reflection against the mountains

title: Rainy side street at night

clues.text: mirror-perfect reflections and zero litter

note: a city street with no trash at all? suspicious

title: Old town street after rain

clues.text: every cobblestone glows like it was polished

note: it looks like a movie set. because it kind of is

title: Barn owl on a fence post

clues.text: the feet melt into the post

note: where are its toes? asking for a friend

title: Pancakes at a diner

clues.text: blueberries like glossy marbles
the fork and knife fuse together

note: too pretty to eat. that's the tell

title: Macaw on a branch

clues.text: parrots grip with two toes front, two back. not this one

note: look at the feet. always look at the feet

title: Old piano keys

clues.text: black keys in one long row: real ones come in twos and threes
sheet music that no one could play

note: a piano with no gaps. that's not how music works 💜

title: Wood-fired pizza

clues.text: char spots stamped on in an even pattern

note: almost perfect. almost

title: Puppy in autumn leaves

clues.text: sitting in leaves, not one stuck to its fluff

note: real puppies come with leaves attached

title: Ramen at the counter

clues.text: a flawless bowl: perfect egg, slices and steam

note: the menu is real japanese now. the tell is how perfect it all is

title: Subway platform

clues.text: the train blur is too smooth, like a filter

note: cleanest subway platform in history 🙈

title: Sunflower under a storm

clues.text: the field's sunflowers face every which way
the star flower poses for the camera, not the sun

note: real sunflowers in a field all face the same way

title: Yellow tram on a hill

clues.text: a city tram with no number or route sign

note: which line is it? exactly

title: Typewriter keys

clues.text: it even got qwerty right. the tell: every key is spotless

note: okay this one is just good. sorry 🙈

clues.text: ferns copied and pasted along the edge

note: nature is messier than this
